description: Schema v2 FACTS, OUTCOME, and TIER-ATTRIBUTION ground-truth labels for 0xdf OSCP/HTB walkthrough cohorts (280 deduplicated blocks: 102 base + 178 Wave-A OX-1..OX-12). Stores zero verbatim corpus output per CORPUS-MINING.md Principle 7; tools/corpus/facts-axis.js re-reads output from the local corpus by block id.

cases.note: Full TCP sweep of an AD DC. Floor: host up, open-port set, and the service reachabilities that drive AD moves.
Version + default-script scan of the same DC. Floor adds scan.nmap.version; still no creds or foothold from a scan.
Small Windows box: ftp (Microsoft ftpd), telnet, http. Floor: host up, open ports, version scan, ftp + http reachable.
Full TCP sweep of Active (AD DC). Floor: DC candidate plus the core AD service reachabilities.

cases.command: gobuster dir -u http://10.10.10.187 -w /usr/share/wordlists/dirbuster/directory-list-2.3-medium.txt -x php -t 20 po scans/gobuster-root-medium-php
cases.note: Gobuster v3.0.1 with real results (/index.php 200, /assets 301, /images 301, /server-status 403). Floor: the content map, and it must contain the discovered paths.

Gobuster v2.0.1 banner-only block: the run started and finished with NO paths shown in this block. Correct behavior is to mint nothing; a true negative. Guard: must not invent a content map from a banner.
PowerShell Invoke-WebRequest style 200 OK with a Server header. Floor: http reachable and the server banner. A GET must not claim a credential.

Freeform labeled credential block: the body discloses three credential sets (internal mail, FTP, WordPress) as bracket-header + bare-user + bare-pass, with no key=value delimiter. Previously the documented facts-axis miss (websource keyed only on config/.env shapes); CLOSED 2026-10-23 by websource `_parse_labeled_creds` (source 'labeled-leak'), which now mints a labeled_leak credential.candidate for this shape. Ground truth: this block should mint credential.candidate.
Version + script scan of an AD DC (Active). Floor: host up, open ports, nmap version evidence, DC candidate, and the core AD service reachabilities. A service scan never yields creds or foothold.
UDP top-ports sweep. Floor: host up, open UDP port set, and the udp-scan marker. No TCP service reachability is implied by a UDP sweep, and no creds.
Single-port https service scan (443 only). Floor: host up, open port, http reachable. Guard: a single https port must not imply ftp or smb, and a scan is never a credential.

SMB probe with an unauthenticated / guest logon that is rejected. Floor: smb reachable, DC candidate from the host banner, domain learned, and the logon-failure blocker. Guard: a rejected logon is never an authenticated session or a validated credential.

SMB logon refused with STATUS_ACCOUNT_RESTRICTION (valid secret, but the account cannot log on this way). Floor: smb reachable and the account-restricted blocker. Guard: a restricted logon did not authenticate the session.

SMB logon accepted (plus sign, no Pwn3d marker). Floor: smb reachable, authenticated session, validated and available credential. Guard: a non-admin logon is not admin access, and it is not a logon failure.

SMB share listing that exposes a Groups.xml (GPP) file worth pulling. Floor: the loot file pointer and a config-review flag. Guard: an undecrypted GPP file is not yet a plaintext or available credential.

HTTP 404 error body (PowerShell Invoke-WebRequest wrapper). STRICTER FLOOR / BACKLOG 2026-10-23: the server answered over HTTP, which proves http.reachable; the curl parser mints that for a clean 200 + Server header (case 25f59588e9ad) but not for this error-wrapped non-200 path, so the reachability fact is a tracked miss (the failures-axis HTTP error-body item). Guard: a 404 is not a credential.

SSH session whose banner discloses the uname string and lands on an interactive target prompt. Floor: OS family and kernel learned from the banner; must not mint a plaintext credential from the banner.

Anonymous FTP login accepted, with a server banner. Floor: ftp reachable, the banner, the anonymous-login fact, and the OS family if the banner discloses it. Guard: anonymous access is not a captured credential and not a shell foothold.

FTP directory listing that exposes backup.mdb (a 5.6MB Access DB worth pulling). STRICTER FLOOR / BACKLOG 2026-10-23: a listing that names a loot-worthy file should mint loot.files the way smbclient listings already do; the ftp listing path does not yet, so this is a tracked facts-axis miss, not a test failure. Guard: a listing is still not a credential or a foothold.
Feroxbuster run with discovered paths. Floor: the web content map. Guard: content discovery never yields a credential.
Gobuster v3 run with real results and a tech hint from the responses. Floor: the content map and the web tech fact. Guard: content discovery is not a credential.
Gobuster v2 banner-only block: the run header printed but no paths are shown in this block. Correct behavior is to mint nothing. True-negative guard: no content map from a banner.
mssqlclient.py interactive session established (SQL prompt). Floor: a database session. Guard: opening a DB shell is not OS admin access and is not a captured credential.

sqlmap confirmed injection with a dump that surfaces databases, tables, and credential columns. Floor: injection confirmed, databases, tables, dumped creds, and a credential candidate. Guard: a DB dump is not a shell on the host.
sqlmap confirmed injection with database enumeration, no dump yet. Floor: injection confirmed and the database list. Guard: a confirmed injection without a dump is not yet a credential.
AS-REP roast that returns a crackable hash. Floor: the asrep hash and a credential candidate. Guard: an uncracked hash is not an available credential and not a windows foothold.

AS-REP request against a user that has pre-authentication required: no hash returned. Correct behavior is to mint nothing. True-negative guard: no asrep hash and no credential candidate from a pre-auth-required response.

GetUserSPNs listing the SPN table (request hashes saved to a file, not shown inline here). Floor: the AD user list learned from the SPN table. Guard: an SPN listing without an inline ticket is not a captured credential.
Reading back a Kerberoast output file that contains a TGS ticket hash. Floor: the tgs hash and a credential candidate. Guard: an uncracked ticket is not an available credential and not a foothold.
LDAP bind rejected with invalid credentials. Correct behavior is to mint nothing. True-negative guard: a failed bind did not validate the credential and did not enumerate users.

Local SAM dump yielding NTLM hashes. Floor: the ntlm hashes, a credential candidate, the SAM loot pointer, and an available credential (the hash can pass-the-hash). Guard: a hash is not a plaintext password.

DCSync / NTDS dump yielding domain hashes including krbtgt. Floor: the ntlm hashes, the krbtgt hash, the NTDS loot pointer, a credential candidate, and an available credential. Guard: domain hashes are not plaintext.
Hashcat cracks a hash to plaintext. Floor: the recovered plaintext and an available credential. Guard: cracking a ticket does not by itself place a windows foothold.

John cracks an SSH private-key passphrase. Floor: a credential candidate (the key), the recovered plaintext passphrase, and an available credential. Guard: cracking a passphrase is not yet a linux foothold.
sudo -l showing a NOPASSWD entry for a specific binary. Floor: the sudo rights, the specific sudo binary, and the privesc lead. Guard: a sudo right is a lead, not yet confirmed root access.
sudo -l showing (ALL : ALL) ALL. Floor: the sudo rights and the privesc lead. Guard: the right to escalate is a lead, not yet root access until a shell confirms it.
rpcclient enumdomusers returning domain accounts. Floor: the AD user list. Guard: enumerating users is not a captured credential.

evil-winrm connection banner only (Establishing connection), no shell prompt shown in this block. Correct behavior is to mint nothing from the banner. True-negative guard: a connection banner is not admin access and not a captured credential.

Successful 200 HTML fetch through proxychains (the S-chain prints OK and the page title renders). STRICTER FLOOR / BACKLOG 2026-10-23: a 200 response proves http.reachable, but the proxychains prefix and the absent status/header lines defeat the curl reachability parser, so it mints nothing. Tracked miss. Guard: fetching a page is not a captured credential.

curl against a hostname that does not resolve (DNS failure, no connection made). Correct behavior is to mint nothing. True-negative anchor paired with the HTTP error-body backlog above: when the error-response parser is built it must NOT fire http.reachable on a name-resolution failure, where nothing was ever reached.

Kerberos-authenticated Impacket dacledit.py write operation granting FullControl over a target directory object and printing DACL modified successfully. Must emit ad.control_paths without prematurely minting domain admin, NTDS loot, or an interactive Windows foothold.

Kerberos ccache-authenticated Evil-WinRM connection opening an interactive PowerShell prompt as a non-admin domain user. Must emit WinRM authentication, validated credential proof, interactive shell, and Windows foothold without promoting to administrative or SYSTEM privilege.

Local gpp-decrypt invocation decrypting an AES-encrypted Group Policy Preferences cpassword string into a single cleartext password line on stdout. Must emit credential.candidate and credential.plaintext with outcome success rather than dropping bare gpp-decrypt stdout as unknown.

NetExec FTP authentication attempt returning [-] <user>:<secret> 530 User cannot log in. Must emit ftp.reachable alongside blocker.logon_failure and refuted credential.validation, classifying outcome as rejected rather than success.

Targeted ACL Kerberoasting writing a temporary SPN onto a writable user object, requesting a Kerberos TGS ticket ($krb5tgs$23$*), and cleaning up the SPN. Must emit hash.tgs and credential.candidate without minting validated credentials or NTDS loot.

Remote Impacket secretsdump.py DRSUAPI replication using a domain account granted DCSync rights, dumping krbtgt and domain NTLM hashes. Must emit loot.ntds, hash.krbtgt, hash.ntlm, credential.candidate, and credential.available without minting an interactive shell foothold.

Interactive unzip extraction attempt against a password-protected ZIP backup containing Active Directory/ntds.dit and registry/SYSTEM, prompting for a password and aborting on incorrect password. Must emit loot.files and loot.material so offline archive-cracking moves unlock, without prematurely minting loot.ntds.

NetExec WinRM credential check printing a [*] Windows host banner followed by a [-] <domain>\<user>:<secret> rejection row without an NTSTATUS keyword. Must emit winrm.reachable, host.os_family, blocker.logon_failure, and refuted credential.validation with outcome rejected.

Successful ansible-vault decrypt pipeline printing Decryption successful on stderr and a YAML key-value service password entry on stdout. Must emit credential.candidate and credential.plaintext with outcome success without minting target shell footholds.

Schannel LDAPS passthecert.py write_rbcd action populating msDS-AllowedToActOnBehalfOfOtherIdentity on a computer object and printing Delegation rights modified successfully. Must emit ad.rbcd, ad.delegation, and ad.control_paths without minting NTDS loot or admin shell facts.

Windows cipher /c inspection of an EFS-encrypted file from an on-host PowerShell prompt where decryption/read access is denied to the current principal. Must emit blocker.access_denied, foothold.windows, and host.os_family with outcome authorization-denied.

Meterpreter migrate command transitioning the session into another Windows process ID and printing Migration completed successfully. Must emit foothold.windows and access.shell with outcome success rather than returning zero facts and unknown.

Command-less LDIF user entry dump containing sAMAccountName paired with a custom base64-encoded *Pwd password attribute. Must emit directory domain/user facts plus decoded credential.candidate, credential.plaintext, and user-bound credential.available without minting shell footholds.

CrackMapExec WinRM logon attempt emitting a [*] host banner followed by a [-] logon failure row. Even though winrm.reachable and host.os_family are extracted from the banner, blocker.logon_failure must drive outcome classification to rejected rather than success.

On-host Windows net localgroup query whose group name and Comment line contain the word Share without listing any SMB share table or UNC path. Must emit foothold.windows and host.os_family while forbidding false-positive smb.shares or smb.readable_share facts.

Arbitrary file read via curl returning a plaintext application INI configuration containing database/LDAP username and password fields. Must emit http.reachable and extracted credential facts while forbidding false-positive web.login_form and web.parameterized facts from non-HTML INI response bodies.

Disclosed PHP polyglot webshell source containing <?php system($_REQUEST['cmd']); ?> followed by a dummy RSA private key wrapped inside a C/PHP block comment (/* ... */). Must emit web.source_disclosed and web.vuln_sink while forbidding loot.ssh_key, credential.ssh_key, and credential.certificate from commented-out PEM text.

Impacket owneredit.py invocation aborting locally with Python/OpenSSL [-] unsupported hash type MD4 before sending any LDAP write. Must emit zero AD control-path facts and classify outcome as environment-error.

Certipy account update modifying a writable domain account userPrincipalName for ESC9/ESC10 certificate impersonation and printing Successfully updated. Must emit ad.control_paths without prematurely minting domain admin or certificate facts.

Certipy PKINIT authentication using an ESC9-enrolled domain admin PFX certificate, saving a TGT ccache and recovering the principal NT hash. Must emit hash.ntlm, credential.available, and access.admin without minting NTDS dump or interactive shell facts.

NetExec SMB guest RID brute-force against a modern Windows Server 2022 DC banner reporting SMBv1:False must mint smb.guest_session and ad.user_list without minting a supported smb.smbv1 fact or authenticated named-user access.

Impacket reg.py remote SeBackupPrivilege registry hive dump saving HKLM\SAM, HKLM\SYSTEM, and HKLM\SECURITY must mint loot.sam and loot.files and classify as success.
